annotation.title_clean: UAE's International Stance on Artificial Intelligence Policy
annotation.title_en: UAE's International Stance on Artificial Intelligence Policy
annotation.authors_or_issuer: UAE Ministry of Cabinet Affairs (UAE Legislation portal)
annotation.summary_en: UAE government policy document setting out the country's international stance on AI: active participation in multilateral forums, support for international alliances and rules, and six guiding principles (progress, collaboration, community, ethics, sustainability, safety). It builds on the UAE AI Charter and the eight-principle AI Principles and Ethics framework. No robotics-specific provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Engage in international forums shaping AI standards and guidelines
Support international alliances and rules holding nations accountable for harmful AI development
Adopt eight AI ethics principles: fairness, accountability, transparency, explainability, resilience, safety, human values, sustainability and privacy
Join the Hiroshima AI Process Friends Group and rely on the UAE Cybersecurity Council
Promote AI innovation, equitable access and upskilling for economic diversification
